WITH linked_executions AS (
  SELECT o.orderbase, e.fillcount
  FROM orderexecutions AS e
  JOIN orders AS o ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault
), channel_counts AS (
  SELECT orderbase, AVG(fillcount) AS avg_filled_quantity, COUNT(*) AS execution_count
  FROM linked_executions
  GROUP BY orderbase
)
SELECT orderbase AS channel,
       avg_filled_quantity,
       execution_count,
       1.0 * execution_count / SUM(execution_count) OVER () AS execution_fraction
FROM channel_counts;
